title: Stylebook Closet Category Imbalance
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=style:wardrobe category=*
| stats count as items by category
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval share_pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - share_pct
description: Shows how closet items split across category for Stylebook inventory.
value: Share-of-total views make it easier to see imbalance, over-concentration, and neglected areas inside Stylebook inventory.
implementation: Capture each closet items event in `style:wardrobe` and normalize `category` so Splunk can compute the share by category.
visualization: Table of category with item count and share percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how closet items are divided across category so you can tell if one part of Stylebook inventory is taking over.
